bias_flags.why: Exclusionary phrasing. It reads as a culture signal rather than a skill requirement and deters qualified applicants who don't self-identify with it.

bias_flags.phrase: Required skill 'aws' — only 1/18 candidates show it
bias_flags.why: This requirement screens out 94% of the uploaded pool. As a hard filter it rejects nearly every applicant — including the strongest — before a human ever looks.
bias_flags.suggestion: Demote aws to nice-to-have; it is trainable on the job for a junior role.

bias_flags.phrase: Required skill 'docker' — only 0/18 candidates show it
